misprints.note: The breathing is printed smooth instead of rough.
There is an extra iota in the print.
The form is clearly printed. It is unattested in the corpus, but it may be the book's own coinage.
The abbreviation 'mga' is printed as shown and is kept.

uncertain.note: The accent above the diaeresis is unclear (acute or grave) where the word is split across lines as πρα-ΰς. I chose acute.
The accent above the rough breathing on εἷς is faint. I read it as a circumflex.
